verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Browserbase offers data-pulling and URL-fetch features, but nothing in the evidence shows a developer passing a JSON schema and getting back schema-conforming data. The fetch feature can return a URL as "HTML, JSON or markdown", but that is a generic output format, not schema-driven extraction. The Stagehand SDK claims (natural language selectors, self-healing actions) never mention schema-based structured output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a JSON schema so the API returns structured data matching that schema
